plugin.name: xWeatherRouting
plugin.summary: Upgraded weather routing with departure and arrival planning.
plugin.author: Sean d'Epagnier; Weather Routing Plugin Team
plugin.description: WeatherRouting computes land-aware sailing routes using deterministic forward isochrones, reverse recovery, graph fallback, concurrent departure optimisation, and planned-arrival routing. Stock OpenCPN uses GSHHS land checks; optional chart-backed safety is available only when the host provides it.
